title: Spectral Geroch conjecture and noncompact area enlargeable summands
summary: We prove that the connected sum of a possibly noncompact area enlargeable manifold $M_1$ with an arbitrary spin manifold $M_2$ of the same dimension admits no complete Riemannian metric of uniformly positive scalar curvature. This extends a theorem of Wang--Zhang, where $M_1$ is assumed closed, to noncompact enlargeable summands; in this generality the uniform positivity hypothesis enters the argument in an essential way.
